Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.RuntimeSupport
ChangelogMessages: Bypass any customer-configured proxy (e.g. HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY environment variables) for internal Lambda Runtime API calls. The HttpClient used to communicate with the Runtime API now sets UseProxy = false so requests to the RAPID endpoint are not routed through a customer proxy, which would fail when RAPID is not on a loopback address. Customer handler HTTP calls are unaffected.
